summary: To be clear by "grounded" I meant swim and board withy kids since you can't "babysit your own kids" Nobody tells me when or where I can surf (except my wife, my mom, lifeguards, and one a few occasions the police).
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
To be clear by "grounded" I meant swim and board withy kids since you can't "babysit your own kids"

Nobody tells me when or where I can surf (except my wife, my mom, lifeguards, and one a few occasions the police).
